meta.scope_note: ranking universe = 主板 60/00 only (research common.py:98-101); NOT 全市场

xs_rank_pool.scope: in_universe == True AND x is not null (numerator and denominator are the same sample)
xs_rank_pool.denominator: count(x) over date restricted to in_universe & x not null; MUST NOT be in_universe.sum()
xs_rank_pool.signature: xs_rank_pool(x, mask)  # mask required, no default
xs_rank_pool.formula: rank_average(x over date where mask & x not null) / count(x over date where mask & x not null)
xs_rank_pool.value_range_note: (0,1]; daily max == 1 when pool non-null count >= 1

xs_rank_market.scope: all rows in panel with x not null (main board 60/00, ~3077-3095 symbols)
xs_rank_market.formula: rank_average(x over date) / count(x over date)
xs_rank_market.dedup_note: counts as ONE factor together with rank; do not double count

xs_rank_pct.scope: MIXED: numerator all-sample, denominator in-pool (not the same sample) — defect form, not design
xs_rank_pct.denominator: in_universe.sum() over date (pool count including members whose x is null; ~1429/1430)
xs_rank_pct.formula: rank_average(x over date, all non-null) / in_universe.sum() over date
